lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a consistent inter-blob distance forming a localized grid of approximately 5-6 columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots to form a defined grid of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior edge to lower luminance shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is present on the dorsal ridge line, posterior to the first visible segment of the back.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small-diameter, high-luminance spots, which are significantly more concentrated than the larger spots found on the lateral flank.
